build.beforeBuildCommand: bun run build:wasm && bun run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' ws://localhost:* ws://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Windows Hardware Flight Recorder & Event Log Sentinel
bundle.longDescription: Monitoramento de telemetria Windows em tempo real (Caixa-Preta 60s), leitura push de Event Logs traduzidos em PT-BR, motor de correlação inteligente e PWA remoto via LAN.
